Ten comments

Captain Sudley

Yep another Carolan tune, I love this tune, we played it in a group I was in many years ago with Pipes, Cello, Violin and Harp and it was a perfect tune for this arrangement of instruments. There is another name for this tune but I just can’t think of it.

↳ Posted by JACKB on March 1st, 2007.

I forgot to mention it is not a reel but should be played in a majestic manner.

↳ Posted by JACKB on March 1st, 2007.

Captain Sudley, X:2

Re: Captain Sudley

Maire McDonnell Garvey, the author of ‘Mid Connacht’ researched the notes for Dan Healy & Ciaran O’Raghallaigh’s CD The Wyndy Turn.
For this tune she notes;
《Carolan’s daughter Siobhan married Captain Sudley of the King’s army who was a protestant. Carolan did not approve. He composed this spightly melody as a wedding gift. Little did he think it would last to the 20th century.
" Si Siobhán gheal a’ spéirbhean
Nár chuir spéis i gcruatháin
Lámh na féile
I gclú ’s in éineach
Se sin réim ba dual dí " 》

↳ Posted by birlibirdie on May 15th, 2023.
